Detailed Description: Facilitated half-day or full-day workshop to define brand positioning, audience, and messaging pillars ahead of a branding engagement.
Typical Deliverables: Workshop summary deck; brand brief document
Notes: Often the entry point for new branding clients; frequently upsells into Brand Identity Package

Detailed Description: Full brand identity development: logo suite, color palette, typography system, and brand style guide.
Typical Deliverables: Logo suite (primary/secondary/icon), style guide PDF, brand asset library
Notes: *Some states tax design services when a tangible deliverable (printed guide) is provided — verify state nexus rules

Detailed Description: Modernization of an existing brand identity: updated logo treatment, refreshed guidelines, no ground-up strategy work.
Typical Deliverables: Updated logo files, refreshed brand guideline PDF
Notes: Priced lower than full identity package due to reduced discovery scope

Detailed Description: Ad hoc hourly graphic design support for print and digital collateral outside of a packaged engagement.
Typical Deliverables: Deliverables vary by request; billed against timesheet
Notes: Tracked via QBO Projects/Timesheets for accurate WIP

Detailed Description: Design of a standard business print package: business cards, letterhead, and one signage or brochure piece.
Typical Deliverables: Print-ready files (business cards, letterhead, one collateral piece)
Notes: Print production/shipping billed separately if client requests physical prints

Detailed Description: Client design work fulfilled through a freelance designer and billed to the client at a marked-up hourly rate.
Notes: Two-sided item: billed at $110/hr, contractor cost $55–$65/hr depending on assigned designer

Detailed Description: On-location video production including a full-day shoot with crew and a finished 60–90 second promotional video.
Notes: Studio/equipment rental billed separately as pass-through if used

Detailed Description: Post-production editing service for client-supplied or agency-shot raw footage.
Typical Deliverables: Finished edited video, up to 2 rounds of revisions
Notes: No shoot day included — footage assumed to already exist

Detailed Description: Studio space rented on behalf of the client for a production day, billed at cost plus standard markup.
Notes: Two-sided item: billed $400/day, vendor cost $300/day (Framework Studio Space)

Detailed Description: Specialty camera, lighting, or grip equipment rented for a client shoot, billed at cost plus standard markup.
Notes: Two-sided item: billed $250/day, vendor cost $175/day (ProShoot Equipment Rentals)

Detailed Description: Half-day on-location or in-studio corporate photography session.
Notes: *Delivery of digital files only avoids tangible-goods sales tax in most states

Detailed Description: Full-day on-location or in-studio corporate photography session, suited to multi-location or multi-subject shoots.
Notes: Standard package for real estate and multi-department corporate clients

Detailed Description: Studio product photography for e-commerce or catalog use.
Notes: Popular with retail/e-commerce clients ahead of seasonal launches

Detailed Description: Setup, ongoing optimization, and monthly reporting for a client's paid digital advertising campaigns.
Typical Deliverables: Campaign setup, bi-weekly optimization, monthly performance report
Notes: Ad spend itself is billed separately (see MKT-02)

Detailed Description: Media spend placed on the client's behalf across paid social or paid search platforms, billed at cost.
Notes: Billed at actual spend, no markup, per client agreement

Detailed Description: Half-day strategic marketing planning session covering channel mix, messaging, and quarterly plan.
Notes: Often precedes a Digital Ad Campaign or Social Media retainer

Detailed Description: Custom marketing website design and build, including CMS setup and basic SEO configuration.
Typical Deliverables: Live website, CMS access, basic SEO setup
Notes: Hosting billed separately or passed through to client's own hosting account

Detailed Description: Ongoing monthly management of client social channels: content calendar, scheduling, and community management.
Typical Deliverables: Monthly content calendar, scheduled posts, engagement report
Notes: Most common recurring revenue item in the catalogue

Detailed Description: One-time package of 8 designed and edited social media posts.
Notes: Used for clients not ready to commit to a full retainer

Detailed Description: Setup and ongoing management of paid Facebook/Instagram advertising campaigns.
Direct Cost Account: 5310 Client Advertising Costs (ad spend portion only)
Typical Deliverables: Campaign setup, monthly optimization, performance report
Notes: Management fee is retainer revenue; underlying ad spend flows through MKT-02-style pass-through

Detailed Description: Ad hoc hourly strategic consulting outside of a packaged engagement.
Typical Deliverables: Deliverables vary by engagement; billed against timesheet
Notes: Typically delivered directly by the Founder/Creative Director

Detailed Description: Ongoing monthly strategic advisory relationship, typically for longer-tenured clients.
Typical Deliverables: Monthly strategy call, quarterly plan review
Notes: Highest-margin recurring item — no direct contractor cost

Detailed Description: Software licensed specifically for a single client engagement and billed back at cost.
Notes: No standing vendor; purchased ad hoc per project and billed at cost

Detailed Description: Client-approved travel or incidental out-of-pocket costs incurred while delivering a project.
Notes: Requires prior client written approval per engagement letter terms

Detailed Description: Materials purchased specifically for use in a client production (props, set dressing, signage materials).
Notes: No standing vendor; sourced ad hoc from local suppliers per shoot
